artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with Sewing Machine
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated behind a sewing machine on a table. She sits upright, facing forward. She has a bun hairstyle with a dark headscarf, soft facial features, and light complexion. She wears a dark dress with lace collar, a brooch at the neckline, and earrings. The background is plain, and the photo is framed with a gold-toned border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Blacksmith
artworks.description: The image depicts a man facing the camera with a stern expression. He has distinct facial features and dark, slightly curly hair. He is wearing a dark top hat, a light-colored shirt with rolled-up sleeves, and a dark apron tied around his waist. The man is holding a hammer in his right hand and resting it on an anvil. The background is plain and the photograph is elegantly bordered with a decorative gold frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Oil Lamp Filler
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a young child standing. The child has a neutral expression with visible facial features such as round cheeks and light-colored eyes. The child's hair is short and is visible beneath a dark hat. They are wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt with buttons and a ribbon tied at the neck, paired with dark trousers. In each hand, the child holds a metal container—one smaller and upright in the left hand and a larger one with a handle in the right hand. The image is encased in an ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate detailing. The background is a plain, dark surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy with Oil Can
Portrait of a School Teacher and Class
artworks.description: The image shows a group portrait of twelve people arranged in two rows. The front row consists of seven individuals, while the back row has five. Each person is looking towards the camera. Most of the people in the front row hold books or papers. The individuals have dark hair, styled flat, and are wearing dark, high-collared clothing typical of the era, with patterned, long dresses. One individual in the center front wears a pearl or bead necklace. The background is plain and dark, emphasizing the subjects. The image is bordered in an ornate frame with intricate patterns enhanced by gold detailing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a School Teacher and Class
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people posing together outdoors. The people are positioned closely together, forming several rows with some standing and others sitting or kneeling in the front. The men are wearing suits, coats, and bow ties, while the women are in dresses with long sleeves and full skirts. Many individuals have their hair neatly styled, with men having short haircuts and women having their hair pinned up or styled in various period-appropriate fashions. The background is a simple exterior wall of a wooden building, which includes visible siding and a window. The photograph is bordered with an ornate, decorative frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Bonnet Salesman
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up. He has a neutral expression and is looking directly at the viewer. He appears youthful with a clean-shaven face and short, neatly combed hair. He is wearing a dark bowler hat, a three-piece suit with a white shirt, and a bow tie. He is holding a plaid-patterned hat in his hand which rests on his lap. There is no visible jewelry. The background consists of decorated fabric, likely part of a chair. The image is surrounded by an ornate gold-colored frame with floral motifs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man with Tin Measuring Cup
Portrait of an Electricity Lecturer
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man holding a newspaper. He has distinct facial features, a beard, and mustache. He is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a bow tie. There are stacked books beside him, and the background is plain. The photograph is framed in gold with intricate designs.

artworks.title: Mrs. Cynthia Bower
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated from the waist up. She is holding a knitting needle and yarn, with a neutral expression. The woman has her body angled slightly to the side, her head facing forward. She has neatly pulled back hair, a checkered dress with a high collar, full sleeves, and a white apron over her lap. The background is a plain backdrop, likely used in studio photography.

artworks.title: Marie Ann
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in historical clothing standing in a room. She is holding a cleaning cloth and a feather duster. A table with cleaning objects and a chair with an open book are also visible in the room.

artworks.title: Emma B. Gilbert, Dressmaker
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color (carte-de-visite)
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman seated holding flowers. She has a neat hairstyle, wears a voluminous dress with decorative elements and a dark ribbon. A table next to her is covered with a cloth and more flowers. The backdrop is plain with a baseboard along the bottom.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman Washing Dishes
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing behind a small wooden table, handling plates and a bowl. She wears a dark dress with a high collar, puffed sleeves, and a light-colored apron. Her hair is styled neatly. A metal pitcher is on the table next to her. The background is a plain, textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman Peeling Apples
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated, facing slightly to the left of the camera. She is holding a partially peeled apple, wearing a high-necked dress with long sleeves and a striped apron. She has short, straight dark hair with hints of gray, and there is a bowl of apples in her lap. The background is plain and indistinct.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman Tatting
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with her upper body visible, engaged in sewing or crocheting an item. She has dark hair parted in the middle, wearing a patterned dress with long sleeves and a high collar. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of Three Woman Making Pasteboard Boxes
artworks.description: The image depicts three women from the waist up. The central woman is standing, while the other two are seated on each side. The woman in the center has styled hair with a flower accessory, wearing a high-collared, striped blouse with a white apron. The woman to the left has tightly pulled back hair and is wearing a patterned dress with a checkered apron. The woman to the right has curly hair in an updo, looking downward, wearing a plaid dress with a white scarf. The table in front of them has stacked boxes and ribbons. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman Sewing
artworks.description: This is a grayscale photograph of an older woman seated on a chair, facing us. She appears to be sewing a piece of gingham fabric that is spread over her lap, with one of her hands on the fabric and the other raised up, holding the end of a long white string. The woman has curly dark hair that appears to be pulled back behind her head, pale skin, and round eyes. She is looking at us with her mouth open in a wide smile. She is wearing a high-collared dark dress with long sleeves. In the background behind her there are several horizontal lines that look like wooden fencing in front of a clear sky, with two leafy trees on either side of her.

artworks.title: Portrait of Three Women Cigar Box Makers
artworks.description: The image displays three women sitting side by side, captured from the waist up. They are seated in a formal portrait style with their hands resting on their laps or held up. The woman on the left has long hair pulled back into a braid and is holding a framed photo. She wears a striped outfit with a dark top and a plaid apron over her skirt. The central woman has her hair tightly pulled back and holds a photograph in a geometric frame. She is dressed in a dark outfit with a bow tie at her collar and a light-colored apron over her lap. The woman on the right also has pulled-back hair and is holding a framed photo in both hands. She wears a buttoned dress with a white collar and a checked apron similar to the woman on the left. They are seated on a studio backdrop with a natural scenery background, which includes what looks like painted trees and an indistinct light area above their heads. The ground under their feet seems to be a textured surface, resembling grass or a rug.

artworks.title: Portrait of Four Washwomen
artworks.description: The image shows four women standing in front of a wooden building. The woman second from the right is leaning forward with her hands in a wooden tub. She wears a dark top, light apron, dark skirt, and her hair is tied back. The woman to her left has her arms crossed, wears a patterned dress with a light apron, and her hair is also tied back. The woman on the far right has an apron, arms crossed, and smiles at the camera. The woman on the far left holds a cup-like object, wears a light shawl, and her hair is parted in the middle. The background shows a wooden building exterior and a doorway. The ground appears to be dirt or gravel.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seamstress
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with her hands clasped in front of her. She is wearing a long-sleeved top with buttons and a high neckline, paired with a long striped skirt. She has dark styled hair pulled back, high cheekbones, and a composed expression. She is holding lengths of fabric over her shoulders that match the garment on the floor beside her. The background is a painted backdrop with lush foliage and a distant horizon, and the floor is textured.

artworks.title: Portrait of Four Women Weavers
artworks.description: The image shows four women posing for a portrait. Two women are seated in front, while two are standing behind them. The women have different hairstyles and wear various dresses. They are positioned against a blank backdrop. The photograph is colored and framed with textured cardboard, labeled with "EMERSON, Lowell."

artworks.title: Portrait of a Tinware Advertising Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a full-length portrait. She is standing with her body slightly angled to the side, showcasing her composed expression and short curled hair. She wears a floor-length long-sleeved dress with intricate textures, lace sleeves, and metallic adornments on her neck and shoulders. In one hand, she holds a small flag on a pole, while various household items hang from her waist and arms. The background features a large ornate vase on a pedestal and draped fabric.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Advertising Woman with Leather Products
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, facing the camera directly. She has loose curls and wears a crown with circular embellishments. Her dress has puffy sleeves and intricate designs, along with a sash adorned with medallions and tassels. She holds objects, including a firearm, and wears jewelry such as brooches and belt-like accessories. The background features painted intricate arch designs and faux architecture, evoking a formal setting.

artworks.title: "Anna in Union College Laundry”
artworks.description: The image shows a group of seven people in a workplace. Five women and two men are visible, all from at least the waist up. One man is seated in the foreground, while the rest are standing. The seated man has short hair and a moustache, and is dressed in a dark suit and tie. To his left, a woman sits on the edge of a table, wearing a long dress with a high collar and an apron. The standing women wear long dresses and aprons, with their hair tied back. One woman wears a floral patterned blouse with a belt. Accessories include brooches and an object held by one man. The background features shelves with folded fabrics and bundled items, as well as a metal stove on the right side. The floor is wooden, and the setting suggests a well-organized environment.
